statements.status_notes: Server-side request forgery in the ClickHouse driver plugin, fixed upstream in Adminer 6.0.2. Every product listed is built from upstream vrana/adminer source at version 6.1.1 or later, which includes the fix. The Debian security tracker lists no fixed Debian revision for adminer, so scanners flag every Debian package version.

Every product listed is built from upstream vrana/adminer source at version 6.1.1 or later, which includes the fix. Incomplete fix for the X-Forwarded-Prefix handling (backslash bypass), fixed upstream in Adminer 5.5.1. Every product listed is built from upstream vrana/adminer source at version 6.1.1 or later, which includes the fix per upstream's security advisories. The Debian security tracker lists no fixed Debian revision for adminer, so scanners flag every Debian package version.

Every product listed is built from upstream vrana/adminer source at version 6.1.1 or later, which includes both fixes. Remote code execution via SQLite VACUUM INTO bypassing the ATTACH restriction, fixed upstream in Adminer 5.4.3 by extending the statement filter. Every product listed is built from upstream vrana/adminer source at version 6.1.1 or later, which includes the fix and additionally denies file writes via an SQLite authorizer (fixed in 6.1.1, GHSA-r9r5-j5q8-8c59). The Debian security tracker lists no fixed Debian revision for adminer, so scanners flag every Debian package version.

Unauthenticated remote code execution via MSSQL PDO DSN injection in the server field, fixed upstream in Adminer 5.4.3. Every product listed is built from upstream vrana/adminer source at version 6.1.1 or later, which includes the fix per upstream's security advisories. The Debian security tracker lists no fixed Debian revision for adminer, so scanners flag every Debian package version regardless of the upstream code it contains.

Denial of service via PHP object injection, but only when Adminer is run with Monolog for logging. Debian's security tracker (data/CVE/list) marks this unfixed at every release with urgency unimportant and notes 'Only an issues when using php-monolog, which isn't the case for the Debian packaging' [sic]. Our package (built from upstream vrana/adminer source) is in the same position: upstream's composer.json requires only php, ext-json, and ext-session, and Monolog is not vendored or otherwise present in the shipped adminer.php, so the vulnerable code path is absent.
